parameters.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM customers
  WHERE customer_id = $1
    AND lower(security_answer) = lower(trim($2))
),
txn AS (
  SELECT t.txn_id, t.txn_time, t.description, t.amount, t.channel, t.status,
         (now()::date - t.txn_time::date) AS age_days
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.txn_id = $3
    AND a.customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM c)
),
existing AS (
  SELECT d.dispute_id, d.reason, d.status, d.created_at
  FROM disputes d
  WHERE d.txn_id = (SELECT txn_id FROM txn)
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO disputes (txn_id, customer_id, reason)
  SELECT t.txn_id, (SELECT customer_id FROM c), $4
  FROM txn t
  WHERE t.amount < 0
    AND t.channel = 'card'
    AND t.status = 'posted'
    AND t.age_days <= 60
    AND $4 IN ('duplicate', 'wrong_amount', 'not_received', 'cancelled', 'other')
    AND $5 = 'yes'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  RETURNING dispute_id, created_at
),
marked AS (
  UPDATE transactions
  SET status = 'disputed'
  WHERE txn_id = (SELECT txn_id FROM txn)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
  RETURNING txn_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT customer_id FROM c) AS customer_id,
  (SELECT row_to_json(txn) FROM txn) AS txn,
  (SELECT row_to_json(existing) FROM existing LIMIT 1) AS existing,
  (SELECT row_to_json(inserted) FROM inserted) AS inserted;
